create_SystemPrompt: create a SystemPrompt dataclass with prompt text, zero-shot examples, and a conclusion string
generate_SystemPrompt_augmentation: generate a randomized system prompt string with optional example shuffling and probability-based filtering
subclass_Tool: subclass the Tool class to create a custom agent tool with name, description, inputs, and forward method
validate_Tool_arguments: validate a Tool subclass arguments checking required attributes and authorized input types
generate_Tool_variation_description: generate a random variation of a Tool description with probabilistic hints and zero-shot examples
